Kai Moreno: Starting a concise follow-up for the LB/DNS retry cluster noted in the postmortem. Listing owners + short ETAs. Keep replies brief.
Ellen Park: Summary: control-plane reconfig exposed eu-west fallback nodes with expired intermediate certs; observed retry storms and client-side backoff amplification.
Ravi Menon: I'll take network routing audit (task N1). Validate weighted routes, SNI tags, and any recent BGP adj changes. ETA: 2025-11-11.
Ellen Park: I'll own SEC task (N2): full cert-chain sweep and add an automated chain-validity metric + alert. ETA: 2025-11-14.
Kai Moreno: N3 mitigation: brief edge retry-suppression (60s) after route updates to dampen amplification. Owner: Kai. ETA: 2025-11-09 (canary).
ops-bot: jira-bot: created NET-847, SEC-292, OPS-511  links: https://jira.redwood.corp/browse/NET-847
Maria Chen: Schedule a 09:30 PT sync tomorrow to confirm canary parameters. Post canary logs/artifacts here.
Ravi Menon: A note: implement a 45s TTL prefix cache for SNI mapping as a follow-up test to reduce stale mapping exposure. Will bench before prod rollout.
Ellen Park: Also adding rollback thresholds to N3: error_rate > 2% or retry_rate > 1.5x baseline during canary -> immediate rollback.
Kai Moreno: Thanks. Closing for now — update Jira links and post probe outputs here.
